evals.name: draft-issue
evals.prompt: Write a GitHub issue for adding saved searches.
expect: Explain product value before the architectural and implementation proposals.
Define observable acceptance cases and a completion rule.
Return a draft without implementing or publishing it.

evals.name: improve-legacy-issue
evals.prompt: Improve this issue: Search is slow. Fix it.
expect: Inspect available context before asserting a cause or performance target.
Ask only for missing decisions that affect purpose, scope, or architecture.
Limit performance checks to the required outcome and identified risks.

evals.name: implementation-request
evals.prompt: Implement issue #42 using its existing acceptance criteria.
expect: Do not select this skill solely because the request mentions an issue.

evals.name: bounded-validation
evals.prompt: Draft an issue to correct a button label. The repository requires its documentation check.
expect: Keep the proposal proportional to a label change.
Preserve required checks without adding an exhaustive test matrix.
